I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. I can't confirm or rule out Bay 24 from anything he can see.

I checked the #central-team history and the shared files he has access to. None of them mention an Osprey rollout or a site for Quarrendon Freight Lines, and there's no account folder for it. One old public note covers "Quarendon Freightways", which looks like a different company, so I didn't treat it as the same account. I didn't look in channels he isn't in, and I didn't use message search.

I told him I'll treat Bay 24 as unconfirmed and won't pass it on as fact. If the account owner or the rollout plan confirms the bay, he can post it in the channel.
